admission.justification: Completed landing arcs and open landing-active contracts observed by this process. Losing this boundary would fabricate currentness, attribute another owner's work, hide an external change, or repeat an unsafe host/landing action rather than exposing the actual observation.

applicability: Completed landing arcs and open landing-active contracts observed by this process.
conditions: A completed arc with no valid final gets one attempt, including startup, with four terminal admissions per sweep.
Successful attempts freeze only complete matching facts; failure or final loss never re-arms the same arc.

A real reopen resets the arc; serving-bound calls additionally require actual page interest and use the per-identity semantic-answer due policy, while explicit unbound callers keep their existing refresh API.
exclusions: Abandoned or build-only keys remain probe-free.
No recurring repair of already-attempted terminal history.
